title: A board to work by
note: Tasks, states, projects, the conversation, the status bar, selection and editing.

title: Boards as shared data
note: Each project's tasks as a table the observatory harvests.

title: A lock per clone
note: Two jobs working in the same clone at once merged each other's changes; lab-agent should make that impossible - a job declares the clones it works in, and a second job waits for them.

title: Dialogs for half-manual tests
note: A popup that asks a person, whatever the desktop, and waits for the answer.

title: Instructs any agent
note: lab-agent guide: the living practices from the observatory.

title: Jobs on the lab machine
note: Submit, wait, results, preemption - the agent's hands.

title: Jobs side by side, by the resources they hold
note: A job declares resources (phone:surya, repo:<path>, cpu-heavy); the runner starts any job whose resources are free; the board shows what runs together.

title: Never in the way
note: Updates switch over when idle; notifications only when something changed; waits show themselves.

title: Every wait records itself
note: submit --wait and wait take --on (build, reboot, ci, harvest, ...) and --project; lab-agent writes each wait (start, end, seconds, on, project, job) to its results; a gatherer brings them into the projects' data; the observatory shows waiting beside manual work, and flow efficiency.
